title: JSUT-label: manually annotated phonetic/prosodic labels for BASIC5000
why_promising: Derivative annotation release for the primary JSUT recordings. Repository documentation states that phonetic and prosodic information is based on manual annotation, while time information is automatically estimated. This fits the database only if the genuinely new manual label content can be isolated from the automatic timing and linked without duplicating the underlying JSUT recordings. The public repository exposes BASIC5000 label files plus pronunciation/kana and end-to-end symbol data under CC-BY-SA 4.0-family licensing.
open_question: Isolate manual phonetic/prosodic label fields from automatically estimated times; verify exact relationship to JSUT recording IDs and whether any manual correction of timing occurred; ingest only the new manual annotation layer and lineage-link it to the pre-existing JSUT recordings rather than counting recordings twice.
